paite: Jehu kum sagih alal kum in Joash alal pan hi. Jerusalem ah kum sawmli alal a; anu min Zibiah ahi a, Beer-sheba khomi ahi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Joash / (2 Kro 24.1-16)
english: Jehoash began to reign in the seventh year of Jehu, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Zibiah of Beersheba.

paite: Siampu Jehoiada in Joash asinsak sung teng TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih hi.
english: Jehoash did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes all his days in which Jehoiada the priest instructed him.

paite: Himahleh mun sang teng hihsiat vek ahi tuan kei a; mun sangte ah mite kithoih lailai in gimlim ahal nilouh lai uhi.
english: However, the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.

paite: Joash in siampute kiang ah, "TOUPA inn a laklut thilzek tatna sum teng simsate lak a pai peuhmahte ahinna uh tatna sumte, kuapeuh in TOUPA inn a laklut aphal uh sum tengtengte,
english: Jehoash said to the priests, “All the money of the holy things that is brought into Yahweh’s house, in current money, the money of the people for whom each man is evaluated, and all the money that it comes into any man’s heart to bring into Yahweh’s house,

paite: siampute'n ameltheihte ua pan la uhenla; inn sia, asiatna na bawl uhen," achi hi.
english: let the priests take it to them, each man from his donor; and they shall repair the damage to the house, wherever any damage is found.”

paite: Himahleh hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa Joash bel kum sawmnih-le-thum alal nung in leng siampute'n inn sia abawl kei lailai uhi.
english: But it was so, that in the twenty-third year of King Jehoash the priests had not repaired the damage to the house.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Joash in siampu Jehoiada leh siampu dangte asam a, akiang uah, "Bangziak a inn siatna bawl lou na hi ua? Tu'n zaw na sumkemte a pan dangka la nawn kei unla, inn sia bawlna ding in pekhe zawta un," achi hi.
english: Then King Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest, and for the other priests, and said to them, “Why aren’t you repairing the damage to the house? Now therefore take no more money from your treasurers, but deliver it for repair of the damage to the house.”

paite: Siampute'n mite a pan dangka lak nawn louh leh inn siatna puahphat louh pha asa uhi.
english: The priests consented that they should take no more money from the people, and not repair the damage to the house.

paite: Himahleh siampu Jehoiada in bawm ala a, asin gei avutvang a, TOUPA inn lutna taklam pang, maitam kiang ah atung hi. Huai bawm ah TOUPA inn a dangka tawilut tengteng kongkhak vengmi siampute'n ana koih zel uh.
english: But Jehoiada the priest took a chest and bored a hole in its lid, and set it beside the altar, on the right side as one comes into Yahweh’s house; and the priests who kept the threshold put all the money that was brought into Yahweh’s house into it.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, bawm ah dangka atamta chih atheih un, TOUPA' inn ah kumpipa laigelhmi leh siampu lianpen ava hoh ua, sumte asim ua ipte ah athun khe zel uhi.
english: When they saw that there was much money in the chest, the king’s scribe and the high priest came up, and they put it in bags and counted the money that was found in Yahweh’s house.

paite: Adangka sim uh nasem mite, TOUPA inn lam mite tung a heutute khut ah apekhia ua; amau TOUPA' inn lam mite leh khutsiam mite;
english: They gave the money that was weighed out into the hands of those who did the work, who had the oversight of Yahweh’s house; and they paid it out to the carpenters and the builders who worked on Yahweh’s house,

paite: suangsek mite leh suang laikhe mite kiang ah, TOUPA inn siatna bawlna ding sing leh suangte leh inn bawlna, akhawkna peuh a zat ding in apekhia uhi.
english: and to the masons and the stone cutters, and for buying timber and cut stone to repair the damage to Yahweh’s house, and for all that was laid out for the house to repair it.

paite: Himahleh TOUPA insung a dangka ahon tawi un, TOUPA' inn a ding dangkasik noute, khawnvak puantehnate, maiphiat kuangte, pengkulte, dangka-eng tui-um belsuante, dangkasik tui-um belsuante abawl kei uhi.
english: But there were not made for Yahweh’s house cups of silver, snuffers, basins, trumpets, any vessels of gold or vessels of silver, of the money that was brought into Yahweh’s house;

paite: Nasem mite ape zel ua, TOUPA' inn bawlna in azang uhi.
english: for they gave that to those who did the work, and repaired Yahweh’s house with it.

paite: Nasem mite piak dia dangka akepsak mite uh leng a-etzui pih tuan kei uh. Amau ginomtak in ahih zel uhi.
english: Moreover they didn’t demand an accounting from the men into whose hand they delivered the money to give to those who did the work; for they dealt faithfully.

paite: Mohna thoihna dia thillat dangka leh khelhna thoihna dia thillat dangkate bel TOUPA' inn ah alalut kei ua; siampute tantuam ahi.
english: The money for the trespass offerings and the money for the sin offerings was not brought into Yahweh’s house. It was the priests’.

paite: Huchi in Siria kumpipa Hazael in Gath khua ava sual a, ala a; Hazael in Jerusalem a hoh atum hi.
english: Then Hazael king of Syria went up and fought against Gath, and took it; and Hazael set his face to go up to Jerusalem.

paite: Judah kumpipa Joash in Judah kumpipa apu Jehoshaphat, Jehoram leh Ahaziah in ana latsa thilzek tengteng leh amah thilzekte leh TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn a gou koihkhawmna a dangka-eng om tengteng ala vek a, Siria kumpipa Hazael akhak a; huchi in Jerusalem apawtsanta hi.
english: Jehoash king of Judah took all the holy things that Jehoshaphat and Jehoram and Ahaziah, his fathers, kings of Judah, had dedicated, and his own holy things, and all the gold that was found in the treasures of Yahweh’s house, and of the king’s house, and sent it to Hazael king of Syria; and he went away from Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi in Joash tanchin dangte, athilhihte tengteng Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

paite: Asikhate athou ua, aguk in asim sawm ua, Joash bel Silla zot sukna lampi Millo inn ah asual ua; athatta uhi.
english: His servants arose and made a conspiracy, and struck Joash at the house of Millo, on the way that goes down to Silla.

paite: Amah Simeath tapa Jozakar leh Shomer tapa Jehozabadte'n athat ua; huchi in api-le-pute lak ah David khopi ah avui ua; asik in atapa Amaziah ahong lalta hi.
english: For Jozacar the son of Shimeath, and Jehozabad the son of Shomer, his servants, struck him, and he died; and they buried him with his fathers in David’s city; and Amaziah his son reigned in his place.
